visualCharacteristics.layout: responsive multi-column container with an author-selected ratio (50/50 or 40/30/30)
visualCharacteristics.columnStructure: each column can hold default content or another block

contentPattern: A columns container. The author picks a Layout ratio (50/50 for two columns, 40/30/30 for three) and fills each column with text, images, or other blocks.
usage: General-purpose column layout where the author needs control over relative column widths and wants to nest other blocks. Reusable across the site.
